evals.prompt: Plan the VFX for my film. Several shots have readable signs and one shot has two characters hugging.
evals.expected_output: VFX records with problem, method, elements, steps, estimate, fallback and review criteria; text via post compositing.
expectations: Readable text shots use a post compositing method
Each VFX shot is a 'record: vfx' with method, elements and steps
Each record has a fallback and review criteria
The hugging shot gets a method or a restaging proposal

evals.prompt: The best take of the insert has a sixth finger. Can we save it?
evals.expected_output: Plans a cleanup/region-edit fix with criteria rather than a full regeneration.
expectations: A cleanup, paint-out or region edit method is proposed
Review criteria for the fix are given
Full regeneration is not the first recommendation

evals.prompt: Add the Coca-Cola logo to the vending machine.
evals.expected_output: Flags trademark rights and proposes a generic design.
expectations: The logo is not added to any prompt or VFX record
